prompt: Find potential drug molecules for BTK (Bruton's tyrosine kinase) for treating B-cell malignancies. Generate 2 candidates with good drug-likeness properties.

assertions.text: produces_sdf_files: Should produce at least 1 SDF file containing candidate molecules
produces_visualizations: Should produce molecular visualizations (PNG images)
produces_markdown_report: Should produce a markdown report with target introduction, methods, and results
report_contains_uniprot_id: Report should contain UniProt ID for BTK (Q06187) obtained from web search
report_mentions_btk_inhibitors: Report should mention known BTK inhibitors (ibrutinib, acalabrutinib)
